newsitem.title: GREECE: TWO ATHENS BROKERS NOT ALLOWED TO TRADE ON TUES.
newsitem.headline: TWO ATHENS BROKERS NOT ALLOWED TO TRADE ON TUES.

text.p: Athens stock exchange members Athinaiki Brokerage and Nuntius Securities were not allowed to trade during Tuesday's session after failing to meet clearing house deadlines on delivery of shares.

"The clearing house owed us shares on Friday but delivered them on Monday afternoon. We rushed to deliver by the 14:30 deadline yesterday but we didn't make it and we were barred from trade," said analyst Sotiris Halkiadis at Athinaiki Brokerage.
Nuntius cited the same problem with the clearing house. It obtained shares at 14:00 and had to deliver by 14:30 and did't make it on time.

Athens brkers association has reportedly complained to bourse authorities on the tight trade-plus-two settlement rule which causes problems especially when clearing trades of foreign investors. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
